description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ForbiddenException' for the OrangeHRM system, used to represent HTTP 403 Forbidden errors within the authentication module. It extends the base PHP Exception class and implements Symfony's HttpExceptionInterface, including methods to manage HTTP status code and headers.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: Custom exception class for HTTP 403 Forbidden errors, includes properties and methods to manage status code and headers, and integrates with Symfony's HTTP exception handling system.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the exception, default is 403 Forbidden.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for the exception.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the exception, default is an empty array.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the exception.
